periods.time: First days of Ethics Committee confinement
periods.location: International Mage-Knight League Japan Branch, Ethics Committee basement
periods.summary: Akaza chairs a biased investigation that treats Ikki's relationship with Stella as immoral while refusing to hear his defense. Ikki insists that their love is genuine and not wrong.
periods.cause: The Kurogane faction uses the manufactured scandal to seek evidence for an expulsion request.
periods.process: Red-suited committee members keep Ikki standing, ask leading questions, deride his romance, and mark his assertive answers as bad attitude. Ikki realizes the meeting is a farce but refuses to call his relationship with Stella a mistake.
periods.outcome: Ikki remains confined while the committee seeks a way to break him.
periods.significance: Shows Ikki defending his love publicly and establishes the illegitimate nature of the investigation.
